title: Design Change
description: Schema for tracking a design change between GDD revisions and its impact on features, systems, code, and tests.

id.description: Design change identifier in DC-NNN format

source_document.description: GDD document ID where the change originated

changed_section.description: GDD section ID that was changed

impact.description: Summary of the impact this change has on the project

affected_features.description: Feature IDs affected by this change

affected_code.description: File paths affected by this change

affected_tests.description: Test file paths affected by this change

resolved_at.description: Timestamp when the design change was resolved
